hero.title: How It Works
hero.description: Merchants use existing discounts and Sustainable Discounts™ turns them into Sustainable Discounts™ connected to verified environmental outcomes.

steps.title: Merchants use existing discounts
steps.body: Sustainable Discounts™ converts any existing discount into a Sustainable Discount flow without disrupting the current commerce setup.

steps.title: Choose eligible products
steps.body: Merchants define which products show the contribution option so shoppers can choose in product detail pages.

steps.title: Shoppers choose discount or contribution
steps.body: Customers choose between more discount or more contribution, creating measurable impact directly from purchase decisions.

steps.title: Checkout stays the same
steps.body: Cart and checkout continue normally while contributions are routed to certified projects and tracked over time.

hero.title: FAQ
hero.description: Key answers for shoppers and merchants about Sustainable Discounts™ and climate impact.

items.a: Sustainable Discounts™ helps merchants turn existing discounts into Sustainable Discounts™ that support climate and biodiversity projects.
Sustainable Discounts™ helps increase conversion while allowing shoppers to choose between discount and contribution at no extra platform complexity.
Contributions are directed to verified environmental projects selected for quality, transparency, and measurable impact.

items.q: How can I install Sustainable Discounts™ on my e-commerce store?
items.a: You can install Sustainable Discounts™ from the Shopify App Store and configure it with your existing discount setup.
Sustainable Discounts™ is free to install and does not require a fixed contract to get started.

items.q: Is there a contract required or additional set up fees?
items.a: No. There is no mandatory long term contract and no additional setup fee required to launch.
